messages:
Maria (Sales): Heads up — NebulaCorp wants a joint POC early May. Requirements: customer VPC peering, SAML SSO, HSM/KMS key wrapping, SOC2 reports. They also want pricing for a 2‑week Dedicated pool. Can we do a quick tech handoff?

Devon (Solutions): cc @Jenna (Partner PM) @Li (Infra) @Sam (Ops) — got it. Do we have a runbook / preflight checklist? Also what model and expected QPS?

Jenna (Partner PM): Nebula will run embeddings + chat. Model: open-llama-13B (quantized). Expected concurrency ~20 qps, burst to 50. Avg sequence length ~256 tokens. Data is sensitive (PII) — must be VPC-only ingress + encrypted at rest.

Li (Infra): OK. For Dedicated, baseline is ~4x A100-equivalent for steady 20 qps with caching. HSM support is via customer-managed KMS (AWS CloudHSM / Azure Key Vault). We can enable key wrapping and disable shared NVMe cache for this tenant.

Sam (Ops): Network notes: they'll peer their VPC; we need CIDRs and egress rules for control plane endpoints. Also need estimated egress bandwidth (bps) — any guesses on payload size? We'll need entitlements for telemetry retention and whether they permit aggregated metrics.

Maria (Sales): Pricing ask: ballpark for 2-week reserved capacity + overage rates. They're open to short commit if rate is reasonable.

Devon (Solutions): Ballpark reserved fee: we'll calculate properly, but rough math depends on token volume. Can you ask Nebula for messages/day and percent of generation vs embeddings? I'll prep a canary plan for fallback to a smaller quantized variant if latency spikes.

Jenna (Partner PM): I'll request traffic profile and security questionnaire answers by Friday. They also requested SOC2 report and a recent pentest summary. Tentative timeline: onboard first week of May, 2-week POC following.

Li (Infra): I'm drafting a checklist — will push by Wednesday. Quick preview:
1) VPC peering CIDRs and routing
2) SAML metadata + IdP contact
3) KMS ARNs and HSM contact
4) Sample workload & test vectors
5) Allowed egress IPs and ports

Also sample tenant provisioning snippet:

```
resource "redwood_tenant" "nebula_poc" {
  name       = "nebula-poc"
  vpc_peer   = "vpc-0abc123"
  kms        = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd"
  entitlements = ["dedicated_compute","kms_wrapping","no_shared_cache"]
}
```

Sam (Ops): I'll draft the runbook with rollback steps and fallback to hosted API if dedicated capacity underperforms. Also note: peering usually takes 2–3 business days after we get CIDRs and approvers.

deploy-bot: Tenant nebula-poc staged: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/nebula-poc

Maria (Sales): Action items: Jenna — collect traffic profile & sec questionnaire answers by Fri; Li — infra checklist by Wed; Devon & Sam — pricing calc + runbook. Can we meet Thurs 11am PT to align?

Devon (Solutions): :thumbsup: Meeting booked 11am PT. I'll bring latency targets (95p < 300ms for chat) and a canary plan (fallback model + traffic shaping).

Jenna (Partner PM): Confirmed. I'll add Nebula tech contact to the invite and push SAML metadata.

Sam (Ops): I'll add egress IPs to the calendar invite and note peering timeline.

Maria (Sales): Thanks everyone. If we hit blockers, escalate to eng-oncall.
